channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Chhattisgarh: Sleeping 6-Year-Old Girl Allegedly Kidnapped, Raped Near Village Pond and Left Unconscious; 2 Men Arrested
item.description: A sleeping six-year-old was abducted from her Kanker home, allegedly raped near a village pond, and left unconscious by two intruders.

item.title: Rupee Breaches ₹92 Per Dollar For First Time, Weakens 46 Paise Amid Middle East War-Driven Oil Shock
item.description: The rupee’s record fall reflects how rising oil prices, geopolitical tensions and foreign investor withdrawals are pressuring India’s economy.

item.title: India’s Obesity Crisis Meets Big Pharma: Inside The Rush To Sell Weight Loss Drugs
item.description: As blockbuster weight-loss drugs enter India, experts question pharma marketing, ethics, misuse risks and public health priorities.

item.title: Banned At Home, Thriving Offshore: The New Reality Of India’s Online Betting Market
item.description: India’s betting ban is pushing users offshore, raising concerns over consumer safety, regulation gaps and digital enforcement.

item.title: Report: US Orders ‘Ordered Departure’ for Diplomats, Embassy Staff in Saudi Arabia Amid Rising Regional Tensions
item.description: The evacuation order follows drone attacks on US diplomatic sites and rising tensions after US-Israel strikes on Iran.

item.title: India’s AI Data Centre Boom Drives Investment As Environmental Concerns Grow Worldwide
item.description: India’s rapid AI data centre expansion is driving tech investment while raising global concerns over energy use, water demand and climate impact.

item.title: Is India’s Food Watchdog Failing Us? Inside the Gaps in FSSAI’s Safety Net
item.description: From recurring adulteration scandals to gaps in enforcement, India’s food safety system reveals troubling weaknesses.

item.title: Saudi Arabia Shoots Down 4 Drones Targeting Shaybah Oil Field, Warns Iran It Will Be ‘Biggest Loser’
item.description: Saudi Arabia intercepted multiple drones targeting its Shaybah oil field and warned Iran that continued attacks could severely damage bilateral relations and destabilise the Gulf region.

item.title: Kerala’s Kozhikode Sees Chaos As Viral ₹1 Shoe Offer Draws Huge Crowd, Police Resort To Lathicharge
item.description: A viral ₹1 footwear offer in Kozhikode drew thousands overnight, prompting police intervention and detaining shop owners.

item.title: Iranian Drone Strike Near Bahrain’s BAPCO Refinery Injures 32, Fire At Key Gulf Energy Hub Raises Regional Tensions
item.description: Suspected Iranian drone strike near Bahrain’s largest oil refinery injures 32, escalating Middle East tensions.
